text:
Here are 5 places to visit in Jaipur, numbered on the map below. The positions are approximate.

Amber Fort: hilltop fort north of the city
Nahargarh Fort: best for sunset views
Hawa Mahal: the pink "palace of winds"
City Palace: royal palace and museum
Jantar Mantar: old observatory right next to the City Palace
